home.story.headline: {{years}} Years of Craft, Community & Care
home.story.sub: Founded in Downtown Quesnel, Spa Rivier has been the Cariboo's premier luxury destination since 1985. What began as a passion for beauty has grown into a full lifestyle destination — where spa rituals, salon artistry, curated fashion, and gourmet dining come together.
home.story.body: We believe luxury isn't a price tag — it's a feeling. The feeling of being seen, cared for, and celebrated. Whether you're here for an organic facial, a colour transformation, or a champagne afternoon tea, our team of dedicated professionals ensures every visit is extraordinary.
home.quote: Where every woman is a work of art.
home.team.headline: Personal Care. Friendly Faces.
home.team.body1: From our treatment rooms and salon chairs to our boutique and gift displays, our team brings knowledge, creativity, and thoughtful care to everything we do.
home.team.body2: Whether you’re choosing a skin treatment, finding your favourite jeans, picking out a gift, or booking time for yourself, we’re here to listen, offer guidance, and help you feel comfortable in your choices.
home.team.body3: We believe beauty is personal—and everyone deserves a warm welcome and the freedom to celebrate it their way.

spa.about.hair: At Spa Rivier Salon, we help you look and feel your best with personalized hair services, expert stylists, and premium products. Whether you're looking for a fresh cut, vibrant colour, highlights, or a relaxing salon experience, our team is here to create results you'll love. For {{years}} years, Spa Rivier has been a trusted destination for beauty, wellness, and exceptional service. We're proud to provide a welcoming environment where every guest feels valued and cared for.
spa.about.colour: Whether you're covering grey, enhancing your natural colour, adding dimension with highlights, or ready for a complete transformation, our experienced stylists will create a look that's uniquely yours. We use professional colour lines and personalized consultations to deliver beautiful, healthy-looking results you'll love.
spa.about.waxing: Our professional waxing services are designed to leave your skin feeling smooth, refreshed, and carefree. With attention to comfort and detail, our experienced estheticians provide expert hair removal in a relaxing and professional setting.
spa.about.lash: Enhance your natural beauty with services designed to simplify your routine and boost your confidence. From lashes and brows to ear piercing and other beauty enhancements, our experienced team offers professional services that help you look polished, feel confident, and spend less time getting ready each day.
spa.about.nails: From natural nail care to long-lasting enhancements, our nail services are tailored to fit your lifestyle and personal style. With expert techniques, attention to detail, and a commitment to nail health, we create beautiful, polished results that leave you feeling confident and put together.
spa.about.foot: More than just a pedicure, our foot care services are designed to support the health, comfort, and appearance of your feet. Whether you're looking for relaxation, routine maintenance, or specialized diabetic foot care, our highly trained team delivers exceptional service using advanced sterilization protocols and professional standards that exceed industry norms. You can relax knowing your foot health is in expert hands.
spa.waxing.note: Our estheticians never double dip. Every treatment uses a fresh applicator for your safety and comfort.
spa.foot.title: More Than a Pedicure
spa.foot.sub: Foot care designed to support the health, comfort, and appearance of your feet — from relaxation to specialized diabetic care.
spa.foot.note: Our highly trained team uses advanced sterilization protocols and professional standards that exceed industry norms, so you can relax knowing your foot health is in expert hands.
